subject.title: fix(agents): emit model.failover diagnostic on normal model fallback transitions

question: Which open fallback telemetry PR should be the canonical landing path, and should this branch add committed regression coverage before merge?
rationale: The code path is now source-correct and the contributor supplied real-output proof, but three open PRs target the same canonical issue and this branch has no committed regression test, so automation should not choose the landing branch or coverage bar alone.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Choose this branch because it covers generic and stale `LiveSessionModelSwitchError` failed-candidate transitions from one shared observer, then require or explicitly waive focused regression coverage before merge.

options.title: Prefer the tested sibling
options.body: Move the sufficient proof or implementation direction to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102046 if maintainers value its committed regression tests more than this branch's smaller diff.

options.title: Pause the cluster
options.body: Hold all sibling PRs until maintainers decide a broader telemetry contract beyond the existing `model.failover` event is needed.
